text:
sanjay: Quick heads-up — we need to finalize the plan to change the audit event schema for auth-related events. Goal: remove `client_metadata.v1`, add `actor.ip` and `actor.location`, and version events so downstream customers can validate. Trying to sync on migration runway and KMS/RBAC implications.

elena: Is the removal of `client_metadata.v1` a hard delete or an alias shim for a release cycle? customers still use it in integrations.

sanjay: We want a 2-phase approach. Phase A: emit `v2` alongside `v1` (dual-write), mark `v1` deprecated in docs. Phase B (6 weeks): stop populating `v1` and require `v2` for new consumers.

kevin: Important: adding `actor.ip` could be PII in some regions. We need legal and privacy signoff and KMS tagging for storage. Have we scoped retention? :thinking_face: 

maria: For retention: default audit storage is 90 days. For PII fields we need a flag in the event that marks fields subject to fast-redaction. Suggest `redaction_flags: ["ip"]` on the event and the storage layer enforces it.

isabelle: RBAC change note: we'll add a new permission `audit.view_sensitive` for teams that can see `actor.ip`/`actor.location`. Existing `audit.view` will still show the redacted view. Ops will need to add this to role mappings.

rl-bot: deploy scheduled: schema-props-update -> staging at 2026-04-15T10:00Z, canary 2026-04-16T02:00Z.

kevin: KMS note: events with `actor.ip` must be wrapped with the regional KMS when stored for EU customers. We'll need to annotate event metadata with `kms_region`. Also ensure exporter plugins respect the KMS header.

maria: Draft migration steps (high-level):
1) Create `audit_event.v2` contract with new fields + `event_version: 2`.
2) Start dual emission (v1 + v2) for all auth events for 4 weeks.
3) Add `redaction_flags` + RBAC gating for sensitive field delivery.
4) Ship docs and sample validators + backwards-compatibility FAQ.
5) After consumer opt-in period, stop emitting `v1` data.

sanjay: Posting a quick example of the v2 shape to use in validators: 
```json
{
  "event_type": "auth.login",
  "event_version": 2,
  "timestamp": "2026-04-01T15:22:33Z",
  "actor": {
    "id": "user_123",
    "role": "service",
    "ip": "{{redacted_or_encrypted}}",
    "location": "US-CA"
  },
  "target": { "id": "session_abc" },
  "kms_region": "us-west-2",
  "redaction_flags": ["ip"]
}
```

elena: For the `{{redacted_or_encrypted}}` token we should choose a consistent approach: either encrypt the raw IP with customer KMS (preferred) or hash it with a salt. Hashing blocks forensic work. Encrypt+KMS allows authorized teams to decrypt.

kevin: Agreed on encrypt+KMS. We'll add a new API path in the storage layer: `store_audit(event, encryption_policy)`. Encryption policy values: `none`, `kms-customer`, `kms-default`.

isabelle: Action item for RBAC: update role-mapping spreadsheet and submit PR to authz service to add `audit.view_sensitive`. Owners: isabelle (authz), kevin (storage), elena (privacy). ETA for PRs: EOD 2026-04-10.

maria: Consumer-facing validation: we'll publish a small validator script and a sample CloudWatch/ELK ingest mapping. Suggest we also publish a compatibility test harness so customers can run against their integrations.

ops-bot: reminder: schedule a customer webinar + migration notice email one week before dual-write start.

sanjay: Risk notes: 1) We'll need to monitor schema churn to avoid breaking old SDKs. 2) KMS per-tenant adds perf + cost — ops to estimate. 3) Legal to approve redaction policy.

elena: Privacy check: I'll loop in legal (cc @legal-team) and propose a minimal dataflow diagram. Also will draft the data-processing addendum language for audit fields.

kevin: Perf ask: storage team — can you prototype encrypt-on-write CPU overhead for 1k/sec event ingress? If >15% cpu hit we need to consider batching or hardware offload.

maria: I'll own the docs and validator. Draft will be in `docs/audit/v2-migration.md` and sample validator in `tools/audit-validator`.

isabelle: RBAC mapping PR: I'll open by EOD and tag `@sre` and `@product-security` for review.

sanjay: OK — to summarize the timeline:
- 2026-04-10: RBAC + storage PRs opened (owners assigned).
- 2026-04-15: Dual-write to staging starts (rl-bot deploy).
- 2026-04-22: Public dual-write to prod (canary + rollout).
- 2026-05-29: Target deprecation of v1 if no major blockers.

elena: I'll set up the privacy signoff meeting for 2026-04-08.

maria: I'll post the initial docs draft by 2026-04-09 and the validator by 2026-04-12.

kevin: I'll get a storage perf estimate by 2026-04-07.

sanjay: Thanks everyone. If you have blockers DM me. :thumbsup:

isabelle: +1 — filing follow-up tickets now.
